item.title: StupidMirror 0.7.6
item.description:
• In the Claude desktop app, the live phone now opens in the Browser pane before Claude's first StupidMirror step, without being asked. The Claude plugin (0.1.6) adds a hook: if the first StupidMirror call of a session is not open_viewer, it is turned back once with instructions to open the pane first. The terminal CLI is unaffected.
  • The viewer opens on the device Claude is working with and follows it when Claude switches to another one, so there is no device to pick. Before Claude names a device, it opens on the one already capturing, else the first connected one.
